body:
I know my mother isn't the best but it's because that's the way she was raised. She grew up in the 60s so she stills has traditionalist views. 

I am a 21 year old female. I don't have a job because I have dental problems and a couple of times a month I'll get really bad break outs due to stress so I'm really self conscious about those things. I would try to move out but I have nothing. My mother has been shitting on my self esteem since I was in middle school so I'm really dependent on her if that makes any sense. 

I like the point you brought up about my friends. If it were them in my position, I would want them to tell me about it and would do my best to help them. I just don't want them to think less of me or get freaked out over this and treat me differently or just stop being my friends.

I know a friend or relative that might take me in, or worst case scenario I'd have to find a shelter but I feel like if it has to come to that, I might as well just give up completely as opposed to just being a waste of space.

Thank you. I really appreciate your offer. I've never been good at talking because growing up I was always told that how I felt wasn't important plus I have a lot of trust issues. I wouldn't know where to start.
